adversarialReviewOfOwnDesign: Question: does defaulting the persona/CITY_KEY on ANY cityKey param (not just an explicit-and-present one) risk silently changing the standalone product's behavior? Answer: this was caught and corrected mid-build -- the first draft of plan-review's requireGate() matched against the FALLBACK-APPLIED CITY_KEY value, which meant a bare standalone visit (city defaults to template-city) ALSO matched the template-city persona, changing standalone behavior. Caught by the isolated-logic test itself failing on that exact case, not by a review. Fixed by gating on the raw cityKeyParam() call instead of the fallback-applied constant.

Question: does a cityKey containing special characters risk breaking the embed URL or enabling query-param injection? Answer: covered by a dedicated test -- URLSearchParams.set() encodes the value, verified against a cityKey containing both & and =.

Question: is staff-review.mjs's separate, unfixed embed-URL builder a live gap this card should have closed? Answer: verified by grep that it has zero callers anywhere in the repo outside its own test file -- fixing dead code would not change any live behavior and would be scope creep beyond what's actually broken. Flagged as a separate dormant-code finding instead.
